tasks.analysis: Human cognition refers to the mental processes involved in acquiring, processing, storing, and using knowledge. These include the ways that people interpret sensory signals (perception), how we store and retrieve information (memory), how language is produced (speech), and how humans analyze and solve problems. Researchers study cognitive functions to uncover how the brain processes information and how these processes influence behavior.
